question: Which of the following cities does NOT have the Jantar Mantar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jantar Mantar** is a collection of architectural astronomical instruments built by Maharaja Jai Singh II.
 
• There are five Jantar Mantars in India, located in **Delhi, Jaipur, Ujjain, Varanasi, and Mathura**.
 
• The Jantar Mantar in Jaipur is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
